turns.q: I placed an order a few days ago and still have no tracking, where is it?
turns.replyTail: Could you please provide your order number as well as the email address and phone number used during your purchase? This information will allow me to locate your order and provide you with tracking updates. 🙂

turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
We generally ship orders within 24 to 48 business hours. Once your package has been handed over to the carrier, you will automatically receive an email containing your tracking number.

To allow me to check the current status of your order and provide you with more details, could you please provide your order number, as well as the email address and phone number you used for your purchase? 🙂

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Delivery times depend on the delivery method and your location. Generally, once your order has shipped, it takes between 24 and 72 business hours for it to arrive.

To give you more precise information for your specific order, could you please provide your order number, along with the email address and phone number used for the purchase? 🙂

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?

If your tracking does not update for more than 48 hours, please let me know. In such cases, I can investigate with the carrier to find out where your package is.

To look into your specific order and see if everything is moving as expected, could you please provide your order number, along with the email address and phone number used for your purchase? 🙂
